One half-coach (2 bogies) on 2 km of track at one constant speed. The 16-coach train and the all-day energy are scaled up afterwards in MATLAB (sr_journey), not simulated as a whole train.
SCORE vs the old diagram (22 boxes): 11 in Simulink · 1 partly · 4 ideal stand-ins · 2 MATLAB offline · 4 not simulated

Fixed: the LPV box used to show c* = 2ζ√(k·m) (now corrected in architecture.svg); the sim uses LQR gains blended by load. Added what the sim has: coach & bogie plant, ride-state input, semi-active conversion, C4 push.
